title: SeamlessLogin
description: A Client mod that automatically logs you in to offline-mode servers.
body:
![SeamlessLogin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d95afa0924798f1e3ad894d657bd8793129a3328.png)

  Tired of typing your password every time you join an offline-mode server?
  SeamlessLogin detects the login prompt in chat and sends your password automatically — no commands, no copy-pasting.

  ---

  ## Features

  ### 🔐 Password Manager
  Store a password for each server you play on. Open the manager from the
  multiplayer screen or with a keybind (default: **Numpad +**).
  Each entry has a name, server address, password, and a per-entry auto-login toggle.

  ### ⚡ Auto-Login
  When you join a server with a saved password and auto-login enabled,
  SeamlessLogin watches the chat for a login prompt and responds automatically.
  No input required.

  ### 🎲 Password Generator
  Generate strong passwords without leaving the game.

  - **Password mode** — configurable length (8–64), optional capitals, numbers, and special characters
  - **Passphrase mode** — XKCD-style phrases from a built-in word list, configurable word count (3–8)

  ### 🛡️ Security
  - Passwords are encrypted with **AES-256-GCM** before being written to disk
  - **Password reuse detection** — warns you when the same password is used across multiple servers
  - Show/hide toggle and clipboard copy for safe password handling

  ### ⚙️ Fully Configurable
  - Edit login detection patterns (regex) to match any server's prompt format
  - All settings accessible from the in-game mod config screen
  - Auto-login can be disabled per entry or globally
